metadata.article_title: Residue after usual payments to be paid to residuary legatee.

article.title: Residue after usual payments to be paid to residuary legatee.
article.content:
366Residue after usual payments to be paid to residuary legatee.

Section 366  ·  Part IX · Chapter XII  ·  page 91 of the Act
The surplus or residue of the deceased’s property, after payment of debts and legacies, shall be paid to the residuary legatee when any has been appointed by the will.
